[type]
CompositeLexer

[grammar]
lexer grammar L;
import T, S;
WORD1 : ID1+ { <Text():writeln()> } ;
WORD2 : ID2+ { <Text():writeln()> } ;
fragment ID1 : { <Column()> \< 2 }? [a-zA-Z];
fragment ID2 : { <Column()> >= 2 }? [a-zA-Z];
WS : (' '|'\n') -> skip;

A1 :  { <writeln("\"1\"")> } { <Column()> \< 2 }? { <writeln("\"2\"")> } [a-z] { <writeln("\"3\"")> }  { <Column()> \< 2 }? { <writeln("\"4\"")> } -> more ;
A2 :  { <Column()> \< 2 }? [a-z]  { <Column()> \< 2 }? -> more ;


mode A;
A3 :  { <writeln("\"1\"")> } { <Column()> \< 2 }? { <writeln("\"2\"")> } [a-z] { <writeln("\"3\"")> }  { <Column()> \< 2 }? { <writeln("\"4\"")> } -> more ;
A4 :  { <Column()> \< 2 }? [a-z]  { <Column()> \< 2 }? -> more ;

[slaveGrammar]
lexer grammar S;
SA1 :  { <writeln("\"1\"")> } { <Column()> \< 2 }? { <writeln("\"2\"")> } [a-z] { <writeln("\"3\"")> }  { <Column()> \< 2 }? { <writeln("\"4\"")> } -> more ;
SA2 :  { <Column()> \< 2 }? [a-z]  { <Column()> \< 2 }? -> more ;

mode SA;
SA3 :  { <writeln("\"1\"")> } { <Column()> \< 2 }? { <writeln("\"2\"")> } [a-z] { <writeln("\"3\"")> }  { <Column()> \< 2 }? { <writeln("\"4\"")> } -> more ;
SA4 :  { <Column()> \< 2 }? [a-z]  { <Column()> \< 2 }? -> more ;

[slaveGrammar]
lexer grammar T;
TA1 :  { <writeln("\"1\"")> } { <Column()> \< 2 }? { <writeln("\"2\"")> } [a-z] { <writeln("\"3\"")> }  { <Column()> \< 2 }? { <writeln("\"4\"")> } -> more ;
TA2 :  { <Column()> \< 2 }? [a-z]  { <Column()> \< 2 }? -> more ;

mode TB;
TA3 :  { <writeln("\"1\"")> } { <Column()> \< 2 }? { <writeln("\"2\"")> } [a-z] { <writeln("\"3\"")> }  { <Column()> \< 2 }? { <writeln("\"4\"")> } -> more ;
TA4 :  { <Column()> \< 2 }? [a-z]  { <Column()> \< 2 }? -> more ;

mode TC;
TA5 :  { <writeln("\"1\"")> } { <Column()> \< 2 }? { <writeln("\"2\"")> } [a-z] { <writeln("\"3\"")> }  { <Column()> \< 2 }? { <writeln("\"4\"")> } -> more ;
TA6 :  { <Column()> \< 2 }? [a-z]  { <Column()> \< 2 }? -> more ;

[input]
"""a cde
abcde
"""

[output]
a
cde
ab
cde
[@0,0:0='a',<1>,1:0]
[@1,2:4='cde',<2>,1:2]
[@2,6:7='ab',<1>,2:0]
[@3,8:10='cde',<2>,2:2]
[@4,12:11='<EOF>',<-1>,3:0]

[flags]
showDFA
